note: Held-out split for the eval. heldOut is frozen before any prompt or threshold tuning; once frozenAt is set, cases only get added, never moved. The first four held-out cases are public photos without a scale reference: they test that the pipeline refuses to invent millimetres. Measured-accuracy cases (coin or ruler in frame) are still missing. Photo files stay local in fixtures/photos/ (gitignored); source and license are recorded here.
